title: 4.7 Helping at Home
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Say who does which chore: Ich öffne die Tür. Wir putzen den Tisch. Du wäschst deine Kleidung.
grammar_function: Subject + verb + object; der Tisch becomes den Tisch after the verb.

cards.pedagogy_note:
From inside the familiar home, the adult moves the same door from closed to open. Use before-and-after action evidence, not a still of a door already open. Do not imply travel to school or work.
Teach the new action open. Only the new word is the Learn German target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Continue from that open door: the addressed boy moves it from open to closed, visibly acting on it. Keep door, room and viewpoint consistent; opening and closing must have opposite before/after order.
Teach close, contrasting the same door action with open. Only the new word is the Learn German target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Show a clearly visible pile of shirts and trousers in the familiar bedroom. Garments are large enough to recognize. Introduce clothes as the new noun, not a basket, laundry appliance or fabric-wiping cloth.
Teach clothes. Wash is already familiar from wash my face and is retrieved later. Only the new word is the Learn German target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.

Two familiar family members actively wipe the same table and remove a visible spill or crumbs. Show the action and a before/after change. An empty tidy table alone cannot prove cleaning. Keep the table and room recognizable.
Teach the new action clean on a familiar table. Only the new word is the Learn German target; complete statements belong to the practice stages. Spanish help uses the appropriate verb or noun meaning.
